items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Gozzo and I joined, well Benny, the trumpet section was Gozzo, Fozzo, Muchie and Best.

ctx.x: We were talking about the Goodman trumpet section.
Gozzo and I joined, well Benny, the trumpet section was Gozzo, Fozzo, Muchie and Best. And Benny says, “Gozzo, Fozzo, Mucho and Bozzo” I was going to be.
You had to have a vowel at the end of your name to fit with everybody else.
